title: Judges Follow the Reference: The Derivation Gap in Verifying Tool-Call Arguments
abstract: arXiv:2610.18497v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-call judges evaluate argument values proposed by LLM agents. We find that they accept a correct value less often when their input holds no reference for it, that is, no text that says what the value should be. This happens when the value is a default value from the function schema that the user did not mention, when it has to be inferred, or when the text it comes from was cut from the judge input. We call this drop in acceptance the derivation gap. It appears across all seven judges we evaluate, including System One models CLM and Jev. The gap is not only a truncation artifact: correct default values have the largest gap on a benchmark with no truncation. A controlled source-relocation test shows that judges follow the reference in their input: they favor a visible incorrect value over a correct value whose source is hidden. We introduce DeRef (Derived Reference): a separate model reads the full history without seeing the candidate

translated_title: 评审者依赖参考文本：验证工具调用参数中的推导差距
translated_abstract: 工具调用评审器用于评估LLM智能体提出的参数值。我们发现，当评审器的输入中没有包含某个参数值的参考文本（即没有说明该值应该是什么的文字）时，它们接受正确值的频率会显著降低。这种情况发生在该值是用户未提及的函数模式中的默认值、需要通过推断得出、或其来源文本被从评审器输入中截断的时候。我们将这种接受率的下降称为“推导差距”。这一差距出现在我们评估的所有七个评审器中，包括System One模型CLM和Jev。该差距并非仅仅是截断造成的伪影：在一个没有截断的基准测试中，正确的默认值反而呈现出最大的差距。一项受控的来源迁移测试表明，评审器会跟随输入中的参考文本：相比来源被隐藏的正确值，它们更倾向于选择可见但错误的值。我们提出了DeRef：由一个独立模型在不看到候选参数值的情况下阅读完整的对话历史
tldr: 本研究发现了工具调用评审器中的“推导差距”现象——当输入中缺少参数值的参考文本时，评审器会更少接受正确的参数值，并提出DeRef方法，由独立模型在不看到候选值的情况下从完整对话历史中推导参考信息来缩小这一差距。
en_tdlr: This work identifies the "derivation gap" in tool-call judges—they accept correct argument values less often when their input lacks reference text—and proposes DeRef, where a separate model derives references from the full history without seeing the candidate value to close this gap.
